brand.name: Cropido
brand.description: India's leading digital agriculture ecosystem connecting farmers, buyers, suppliers, service providers, consultants, and agri-businesses.
brand.vibe: Trustworthy, earthy, abundant, professional, accessible, investor-ready

theme.mode: Light mode primary, Dark mode enabled

rules.headings: Never use Inter or default generic fonts for headings. Use Outfit for a modern, approachable tech feel. Employ tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for H1 and H2.
rules.body: Use Plus Jakarta Sans for extreme legibility in complex dashboards and marketplace listings. Multilingual text (Hindi, Bengali) should fallback to system-native high-quality sans-serifs (e.g., Noto Sans).

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing. A premium app avoids clutter. Provide ample breathing room inside cards and around layout boundaries.
spacing_and_layout.container: w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8
spacing_and_layout.mobile_safe_area: Ensure pb-24 on main screens to account for the bottom tab navigation.

buttons.primary: bg-primary-600 text-white hover:bg-primary-700 rounded-full py-3 px-6 font-semibold transition-colors data-testid='button-primary'
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary-500 text-white hover:bg-secondary-600 rounded-full py-3 px-6 font-semibold transition-colors data-testid='button-secondary'
buttons.outline: border-2 border-primary-600 text-primary-600 hover:bg-primary-50 rounded-full py-3 px-6 font-semibold transition-colors data-testid='button-outline'
buttons.ghost: text-light_secondary hover:bg-light_hover dark:text-dark_secondary dark:hover:bg-dark_hover rounded-full py-3 px-6 font-medium transition-colors data-testid='button-ghost'

cards.surface: bg-surface-light dark:bg-surface-dark rounded-2xl border border-border-light dark:border-border-dark overflow-hidden

bottom_tabs.style: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-black/80 border-t border-border-light dark:border-border-dark absolute bottom-0 w-full z-50 h-16 flex justify-around items-center

inputs.text: w-full bg-light_subtle dark:bg-dark_subtle border border-border-light dark:border-border-dark rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-500 focus:border-transparent outline-none transition-all
inputs.search: relative rounded-full bg-light_subtle dark:bg-dark_subtle px-4 py-2 flex items-center gap-2

badges.verified: bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:text-blue-400 text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-full
badges.organic: bg-primary-100 text-primary-700 dark:bg-primary-900/30 dark:text-primary-400 text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-full
badges.trending: bg-secondary-100 text-secondary-700 dark:bg-secondary-900/30 dark:text-secondary-400 text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-full

splash_onboarding.layout: Full-screen imagery with a soft gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 via-black/40 to-transparent) at the bottom. Bold white typography for H1. Smooth swipe transitions.

authentication.layout: Clean, minimal white/dark card centered on screen with a subtle earthy background pattern. Large, rounded inputs. Social login buttons with original brand colors.
features: OTP Verification with visual focus on individual digits

home_dashboard.layout: Top section: Personalized greeting, location, and weather widget (Glassmorphic card). Middle: 'Bento Grid' style quick actions (Buy, Sell, Rent, Ask AI). Bottom: Horizontal scrolling lists for 'Trending', 'Crop Recommendations'.
features: Floating Action Button for 'Quick Sell' or 'Ask AI'

marketplace.layout: Category pills at top (horizontal scroll). Two-column masonry or grid for product cards. Product cards feature large images, price in secondary color, and a quick 'Add to Cart' icon button.

crop_trading.layout: List view of active trade requests. Emphasize price, quantity, and location distance. 'List Produce' is a distinct primary action.

equipment_rental.layout: Large hero imagery for top equipment. Details page includes an availability calendar (Shadcn customized) and sticky bottom bar with daily pricing and 'Book Now'.

agri_services.layout: Directory style list with service provider avatars, ratings, and 'Verified' badges. Service detail page features a booking scheduling component.
features: Service categories: Soil Testing, Consultancy, Insurance

community_feed.layout: Classic social feed: Cards with user avatar, timestamp, multimedia content, and action bar (Like, Comment, Share). Tabs at top for 'Feed / Experts / Trending'.

knowledge_center.layout: Magazine editorial layout. Featured article spanning full width. Secondary articles in a 2-column grid. Video tutorials in a horizontal scrolling carousel with play button overlays.

ai_farming_assistant.layout: Chat interface. Assistant messages in subtle primary-50, user messages in white/dark_subtle. Bottom input bar features text, voice mic, and camera upload icons.
features: Image disease detection results rendered as stylized summary cards within the chat

business_directory.layout: List view with robust filtering (Type, Rating, Distance). Contact actions (Call, Message) immediately accessible on the list items.

messaging.layout: Standard chat list. Inside chat: distinct message bubbles, voice note UI (waveform), and media support.

user_profile.layout: Header with cover image (farm photo) and circular avatar overlapping. Verification badge prominent. Stats row (Crops grown, Area). List items for settings.

subscription_plans.layout: Pricing cards with 'Pro Farmer' highlighted (slightly larger, primary border, 'Most Popular' badge). Features list with checkmarks. 'Enterprise' as a contact sales option.

testing.requirements: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, menus, toggles, tabs) and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.

motion.philosophy: Smooth, purposeful animations that feel native to a premium mobile app.

transitions.page: Slide-in from right on push, slide-out to right on pop.
transitions.modal: Slide-up from bottom with background overlay fade-in.
transitions.button: Scale down to 0.95 on press (React Native / Framer Motion equivalent tap animation).
transitions.skeleton: Shimmer effect for loading states (Marketplace, Feed, Directories).
